note: Task labels from PROTOCOL.md (commit 81502b1), as data. prompt/labelText/rule are verbatim table cells. options: acceptable (model, effort-set) pairs for a single-delegation task; efforts null = no band stated. roles: workflow tasks; fanout = every agent() call site except the last in source order, gate = the last call site in source order (the verifier/merger). A workflow run agrees on model only if every call names a model and every role tier is in its role options.

tasks.prompt: Before I ship this, I want an independent adversarial review of `<fx>/hooks/agent-model-gate.js`: whatever is wrong that nobody has listed yet. Use a fresh subagent so it isn't anchored on this conversation.

Have a subagent propose two or three designs, with trade-offs, for how `<fx>/hooks/delegation-ledger.js` should record the resolved model and the effort of every delegation, workflow workers included.

Have a subagent work out, with an argument or a counterexample, whether `lintScript` in `<fx>/hooks/agent-model-gate.js` can both miss a model-less call and flag a model-bearing call in the same script.
